beats.event: Marlow on the Thames begins telling his African tale
Hired as riverboat captain for an ivory trading company
Reaches Outer Station; sees dying African railway workers
Hears of Mr Kurtz, the company's star trader
Marches sixty men overland to the Central Station
Finds his assigned steamboat wrecked on the riverbank
Spends months painstakingly repairing the steamboat
Two-month steamboat journey up river toward Kurtz
Ambushed by arrows near the Inner Station; helmsman killed
Russian trader boards; explains natives worship Kurtz
Sees a row of severed heads on posts around the station
Emaciated Kurtz appears carried on a stretcher
Kurtz crawls back ashore at midnight; Marlow drags him back
Kurtz's health collapses on the return down river
Kurtz dies whispering 'The horror! The horror!'
Marlow returns to Europe, embittered, withholds papers
Tells Kurtz's fiancee her name was his final word
